method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a date module (safw-dates.l4, built-in date functions only), a seat-neutral core (safw-core.l4) and one seat layer (the employee) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, booleans for definitions and 'if' conditions, numbers, dates and one MAYBE NUMBER; no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; seven regulative rules (the time limits in ss 31, 72B(6)(b), 99D(3), 104A(9), 106(1), 110(3), 235(2)), run with EVALTRACE over plain dates; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Fair Work Act 1994 (SA), register version 22.8.2026, fetched from www.legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 (unauthorised RTF; not the Open Australian Legal Corpus), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/fair-work-act-1994.txt (text sha256 45c9be348faf1d5a48ba1e2fdcdd2a6ed327c6292a623965995587b5b13d385d per its meta.json). Uncommenced amendments (Fair Work (Registered Associations) Amendment Act 2024, ss 3-8, 15, 17(2), 18) are not incorporated. The Fair Work Regulations, the current indexed figures for ss 105A(1)(a) and 109(3), the State earnings statistics for s 4(4) and SAET's severance standard are not deposited and are asked as inputs or left out.

seat: the employee: the employee or former employee (including an outworker, and the association, minor, personal representative or beneficiary who claims for them) who brings a claim under the Act -- for unpaid money, severance on redundancy, an outworker's unpaid remuneration, a civil penalty for unpaid entitlements, unfair dismissal relief, or redress after dismissal for a prohibited reason or for taking part in industrial proceedings (safw-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset

checks.result: 232 assertions written, 232 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control on a scratch copy (the s 106(1) period cut to 20 days, then the s 110(3) period cut to 13) failed exactly the 3, then 4, predicted assertions
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
